alt: 老朋友拿著舊照片對照眼前街景，昔日矮屋農田已變成高樓與鐵道，唯有老石橋仍在原地。
scene_prompt: 白雲蒼狗 means worldly affairs change unpredictably. Contemporary elderly woman and her adult friend stand at the edge of a newly transformed city neighborhood looking astonished and reflective. Woman holds an old unlettered photograph of the SAME street when it had tiny one-story homes and farmland; before them now are a modern elevated rail line, tall apartment buildings, and a community park, with one distinctive old stone bridge recognizable in both photo and present view. Focus on the striking change and their expressions of wistful surprise, not a celebration advertisement for development. Above, natural soft clouds subtly change from a loose white garment-like form on left into a gray dog-like silhouette on right, as secondary poetic clue; they remain realistic vapor clouds without eyes, faces or solid dogs floating. Exactly two arms per human, hands hold actual photograph, coherent city structures and bridge perspective. No signage, written text or symbols. Gentle graphite lines, soft watercolor on textured paper.
